items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

ctx.x: And, um, did they ever play, um, did they ever play any, what you might call, real lowdown numbers, you know, where, um, they played real quiet?
Well, no, I wasn't thinking so much like they had this, um, you know, real sort of slow blues, but they played real quiet and, um, sort of, you know, lowdown, you might say.
